description:
🩸❤️ WHEN ROTARIANS LEAD, COMMUNITIES COME TOGETHER TO SAVE LIVES! ❤️🩸

The Rotary Club of Mulund Oberoi Towers, in association with Fortis Hospital, Mulund, successfully organised a Blood Donation Drive on Sunday, 25 October 2026, at the Oberoi Eternia & Enigma Clubhouse, Mulund.

👏 We are delighted that over 100 residents turned up to support this life-saving initiative!

🩸 Blood cannot be manufactured. It can only be donated. Every donation has the potential to save up to three lives, making blood donation one of the most meaningful acts of service.

🌟 A special salute to the five Rotarians who spearheaded this initiative:

🔹 Rtn. Abhishek Yadav
🔹 Rtn. Shashank Pore
🔹 Rtn. Kiran Khobare
🔹 Rtn. Rakesh Jain
🔹 Rtn. Smita Jayshankar

👏 Heartfelt appreciation to all the Rotarians of our club who contributed their time and efforts, to Fortis Hospital for its valuable support, and to every donor and volunteer who helped make the drive a success.
